required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 36 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is `decision_meta` present, valid, `APPROVED`, and on legal mainline `engineering_branch`?
Does `skill_profiles` use only active skills from `.codex-skills/registry.json`?
Does `codex_execution_report.md` match this decision ID and round ID?
Does `pytest_result.txt` match this decision ID, round ID, and report ID?
Does `execution_log.json` record every required command from command-plan?
Were any omitted or unauthorized commands executed?
Was `current_context_packet.json` regenerated or validated after final-check?
Does `auditor_context.final_gate_status` match current `final_gate_result.json.gate_status`, or does the context packet explicitly mark itself pre-final/stale?
Is there a post-final evidence sync result artifact?
Does the post-final sync gate fail or warn on stale context/final-check mismatch?
Is the new READY job artifact present under `project_state/jobs/`?
Does the job artifact validate with `validate_jobs_dir` or equivalent gate?
Does the job artifact keep runner dispatch disabled?
Does the job artifact keep remote mutation, model calls, reverse solving, database writes, scheduler, Web mutation, and GitHub Actions dispatch disabled?
Are job transitions still backward compatible with existing tests?
Does `decision-preflight.yml` exist?
Does `decision-preflight.yml` validate decision metadata and command-plan without running agents?
Does `decision-preflight.yml` avoid model API calls, runner dispatch, workflow dispatch, external tools, and database writes?
Is `state-gate.yml` or CI workflow coverage updated to cover decision-preflight?
Did this round avoid implementing `agent-execute.yml`, `audit.yml`, self-hosted runner dispatch, or auto-iteration?
Did this round avoid Web/frontend runtime?
Did this round avoid sample solving and external reverse tools?
Did this round avoid cleanup-apply, real deletion manifests, real tombstones, archives, and destructive mutations?
Were `project_state/current_state.json`, `task_packet.json`, `artifact_index.json`, and `negative_results.json` left untouched?
Were `.codex-skills/*` left untouched?
Were `solve_reports/*` and `training_materials/local_reverse/*` left untouched?
Were `project_state/archives/*`, `deletions/*`, `blob_store/*`, and database files left untouched?
Did the implementation reuse existing job, CI, command-plan, execution-log, report-summary, final-check, and run-closeout foundations instead of reimplementing them from scratch?
Did new artifacts carry the current decision ID and round ID?
Did historical sample artifact gaps remain visible but nonblocking?
Did final-check pass?
Did report-summary match the execution report?
Did pytest cover post-final sync, decision-preflight, job lifecycle, project gate, project reports, context builder, and state manifest changes?
Did run-closeout archive this round's report, pytest, decision, and manifest if command-plan permits closeout?
Did the execution report list all changed files and generated artifacts?
Did the final conclusion avoid claiming `ACCEPTED` unless all hard gates and tests support it?
